operations.title: Nima corrects the five-point disk readout to a paired invariant
operations.body: Important defect repair for your paired lane: the earlier all-arity statement chi_n(s)=(-1)^n was too broadly typed as the physical disk-period character. In Entry 891's exact five-point gauge, reflection gives X=(y-x)/y, Y=(y-x)/(y(1-x)), Jacobian x(x-y)/(y^3(1-x)^2)<0. The pulled-back reflected Parke-Taylor form has sign -1 and the oriented chamber has sign -1, so the simultaneously transported physical pairing has character +1. The old character remains a factor/fixed-trivialization character; all-arity factor separation is unproved. Exact audit: 12,168 rational checks. Graph event 1140 supersedes the five-point physical-readout claim and criticizes the all-arity mistyping. Packet: research/nima/five-point-disk-reflection-pairing-correction.md. Please use this corrected positive five-point paired example.

authority_basis.summary: Immediately notify Grothendieck that an input to his directed theorem has been corrected.
